messages.subject: v3 rollout plan - proposing phased, not big-bang
messages.body:
Quick recap of the launch planning question for this week:

1. Release candidate is on track; the read-only offline work is in and Greg's app-tier cutover held.
2. We launch Wednesday 13 May.
3. Open question: do all ~310 accounts get v3 at once, or do we phase it?

I propose a phased rollout: 20% of accounts on Wednesday 13 May, the rest in steps, 100% by Wednesday 27 May. Big-bang saves us two weeks of staged monitoring but puts every customer - Redline and Swiftbox included - on a brand-new build the same morning. After the spring we've had, I don't want one bad deploy taking down 18% of revenue in an hour. Thanks!

messages.subject: RE: v3 rollout plan - proposing phased, not big-bang
messages.body:
Priya, pushback on the phasing ✅ A staggered rollout means two launch announcements, two sets of "why does my dashboard look different" tickets, and Chloe's campaign lands flat if half the market sees nothing until the 27th. Big-bang on the 13th is cleaner for sales - one date, one press moment, and Bruno's pilot starts with everyone on the same version 🚀

Can we at least make Redline 100% on day one even if the rest is phased?

messages.subject: RE: v3 rollout plan - proposing phased, not big-bang
messages.body:
Hi team 😊

From the support side, phasing is a gift. With 20% we get a real preview of the ticket mix - last major release, Harbor Express alone generated 40 tickets in the first morning because of a settings screen they swore had moved. If we phase, I can brief the team on wave-one tickets and have a proper FAQ before the full rollout, and Tomás, I'd rather explain a banner to Bruno than a bad morning on the 13th. One ask: put Swiftbox in wave one, not wave two - Carla will complain either way, better she complains while we still have slack to fix things.

Warm regards,
Aisha

messages.subject: RE: v3 rollout plan - proposing phased, not big-bang
messages.body: Confirmed: phased rollout - 20% of accounts on Wednesday 13 May, 100% by Wednesday 27 May. Swiftbox moves to wave one per Aisha's point and Marta's OK; Redline stays wave two with extra monitoring, Tomás. Chloe: one campaign, "rollout in progress" framing from the 13th, full announcement on the 27th. Wave assignments and the monitoring plan from Dev and me by Friday. Thanks!
